items.html: Yet it is certain that by the departure of the light above the Tabur it would have sufficed for the world of Atzilut to be able to receive its light, but it would not have sufficed to give strength to the world of Beria so that it, too, could receive its light. Therefore He added another discernment: to place there that screen and Parsa. It turns out that they are two things: the restriction of the light upward, so that Atzilut could receive its light — and the reason is that by its ascent upward a new light came out, and certainly that light came diminished, so that although it is from the name SAG itself, they were able to receive it; and the matter of the Parsa was so that Beria, too, would be able to receive its light.
